title: Explicit Formula Of The Critical Mass And The Energy Ground State Solution For The Mixed Local-Nonlocal Schrodinger Equation For The In-Between Critical Exponents Case
summary: Our first main contribution consists in establishing an explicit formula of the critical mass via the best constant of the Gagliardo-Nirenberg inequality for the mixed local-nonlocal Laplacian. We also prove the existence of an optimizer of the Gagliardo-Nirenberg inequality for the mixed local-nonlocal operator. We then show that the optimizer (after some suitable scaling) is an energy ground state solution (with critical mass ).
